hero.headline: Build real skills. Ship real work.
hero.subheadline: A focused mentorship where you research, build, get feedback, and ship every week.

mentorship.title: Direction, not spoon-feeding.
mentorship.body: Get a clear weekly brief, do the work, and grow through real feedback.

howItWorks.title: Monday brief
howItWorks.detail: Get your weekly outline and project brief at 09:00 WAT.

howItWorks.title: Build & ask
howItWorks.detail: Research, practice, and ask for clarification when stuck.

howItWorks.title: Sunday ship
howItWorks.detail: Submit your repo before the Sunday 11:59 PM WAT cutoff.

howItWorks.title: Review & grow
howItWorks.detail: Apply feedback, unlock next week; if late, submit a reason for mentor review to request access.

whyUs.title: Ship real repos
whyUs.detail: Progress is earned through GitHub submissions, not passive watching.

whyUs.title: Honest AI use
whyUs.detail: Use AI to learn and build faster — but explain it honestly, never fake the work.

whyUs.title: Clear scoring
whyUs.detail: A transparent 4-pillar scorecard: Projects 45%, Understanding & Code Quality 25%, Discussion & Participation 15%, Weekly Tasks 15%.

successStories.name: Next-Gen
successStories.outcome: A student-built project shipped with a live deployment and public GitHub repository.

successStories.name: Weather App
successStories.outcome: A weather application built during cohort work, demonstrating API use and deployment.

successStories.name: Week 7 Project
successStories.outcome: A weekly capstone project showing consistent progress, iteration, and shipping.
